description: This source file defines the CommandResolver enum in Swift, which provides various static methods for resolving commands, paths, and SSH targets for running the openclaw application environment. It manages locating executables, constructing command line arguments, handling SSH remote commands, and retrieving configuration settings related to the openclaw runtime and project setup.

methods.name: gatewayEntrypoint
methods.description: Locates the main entry point script for the openclaw runtime based on common filenames and paths within a given root URL.

methods.name: runtimeResolution
methods.description: Resolves runtime configuration for openclaw, possibly asynchronously.

methods.name: runtimeResolution(searchPaths:)
methods.description: Resolves runtime configuration for openclaw with optional specified search paths.

methods.name: makeRuntimeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command line arguments to execute the runtime with specified entrypoint, subcommand, and additional arguments.

methods.name: runtimeErrorCommand
methods.description: Generates a command that outputs a runtime resolution error message.

methods.name: errorCommand
methods.description: Creates a shell command that outputs an error message and exits with status 1.

methods.name: projectRoot
methods.description: Determines the project root directory, using saved defaults, fallback paths, or user's home directory.

methods.name: setProjectRoot
methods.description: Stores a given project root path into user defaults.

methods.name: projectRootPath
methods.description: Returns the path of the current project root as a string.

methods.name: preferredPaths
methods.description: Builds a list of preferred executable search paths based on environment, user, and project-specific paths.

methods.name: preferredPaths(home:current:projectRoot:)
methods.description: Constructs a prioritized list of paths for locating executables, respecting development settings.

methods.name: openclawManagedPaths
methods.description: Returns paths managed by openclaw, such as local bin directories for node tools.

methods.name: nodeManagerBinPaths
methods.description: Locates node version manager paths (Volta, asdf, fnm, nvm) within the user's home directory.

methods.name: versionedNodeBinPaths
methods.description: Finds node version directories and constructs paths to their bin directories.

methods.name: findExecutable
methods.description: Searches for an executable file in given or default search paths.

methods.name: openclawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the openclaw CLI executable path.

methods.name: projectOpenClawExecutable
methods.description: Locates the openclaw executable within the project directory, typically after npm/yarn install.

methods.name: nodeCliPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the node CLI script for openclaw if available.

methods.name: hasAnyOpenClawInvoker
methods.description: Checks for existence of any invocation method: the openclaw CLI, pnpm, or node.

methods.name: openclawNodeCommand
methods.description: Constructs the command array to invoke openclaw through Node.js or remote SSH, with subcommand and extra arguments.

methods.name: openclawCommand
methods.description: Public interface for constructing the openclaw command, aliasing `openclawNodeCommand`.

methods.name: sshNodeCommand
methods.description: Builds an SSH command line to run openclaw on a remote host with specified settings, handling various remote invocation options.

methods.name: connectionSettings
methods.description: Retrieves SSH connection settings, including target, identity, project root, and CLI path from user defaults and configuration.

methods.name: connectionModeIsRemote
methods.description: Checks whether the current connection mode is set to remote SSH.

methods.name: sanitizedTarget
methods.description: Cleans and trims an SSH target string, removing any leading 'ssh'.

methods.name: parseSSHTarget
methods.description: Parses an SSH target string into user, host, and port components.

methods.name: sshTargetValidationMessage
methods.description: Validates an SSH target string, returning an error message if invalid.

methods.name: shellQuote
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in shell commands.

methods.name: expandPath
methods.description: Expands a filesystem path, resolving tilde to home directory.

methods.name: normalizeSSHTargetInput
methods.description: Normalizes SSH target input strings for consistent parsing.

methods.name: isValidSSHComponent
methods.description: Checks if an SSH component string is valid, optionally allowing leading dashes.

methods.name: makeSSHTarget
methods.description: Constructs an SSHParsedTarget struct from user, host, and port components after validation.

methods.name: sshTargetString
methods.description: Converts an SSHParsedTarget back into string form 'user@host' or 'host'.

methods.name: sshArguments
methods.description: Builds the argument list for ssh command, including port, identity, and remote command.
